observations: Single headlight assembly for a 2018 Acura MDX.
Five circular projector lenses are visible in the main housing.
The housing appears to be a factory OEM part with no visible aftermarket branding or stickers.
The assembly is resting on a tiled floor with some plastic wrapping.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI JARDON OYIGA' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The photo shows a headlight, but the specific model year and brand are not clearly legible on the part.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The item may be a generic aftermarket part rather than an original Acura part.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate or the part number stamped into the housing.

risks.risk: The internal bulbs may be old, dim, or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the headlight being switched on and the bulbs burning at full brightness.

risks.risk: The housing may be cracked or have internal damage not visible from the outside.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens glass and the interior of the housing.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's part number stamped into the housing.
Video of the headlight powered on to confirm the bulbs work.
Close-up photo of the lens glass to check for cracks.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
